name: Customer Support Email Classifier
businessNarrative: This workflow automatically triages incoming customer support emails for FairTix's ticket marketplace, classifying them into categories like FAQ, account issues, payments, bugs, resales, and feedback while also detecting customer sentiment. The AI-powered classification enables support teams to prioritize and route tickets appropriately, improving response times and customer satisfaction. The detailed classification schema reveals FairTix deals with complex ticketing operations including fair queuing systems, resale caps, and verification processes, indicating a sophisticated marketplace with significant transaction volume.
